messages:
maria_ae: Quick sync on FinSys POC run. They want a formal validation: 8h test window, 2 steady-state profiles (200 qps sustained), one 60s burst to 1k qps, and cost estimate per 1M tokens. Also need tail-latency (95/99) pass/fail, plus GPU utilization and per-token cost breakdown. Can we confirm infra and acceptance criteria?

sam_soleng: We can provision dedicated nodes in sales-dedicated-2. Question: do they require streaming=true for the run or do they want non-streamed baseline? Also confirm sequence lengths: prompt avg 320, completion avg 80 like before? Any pref for KV cache (on/off) and retention rules?

maria_ae: FinSys confirmed streaming=true, prompt ~320 tokens, reply ~80 tokens. They explicitly require KV cache in-memory only (no disk or shared cache). Retention must be zero between sessions.

jordan_ml: I'll generate two replay corpora: "context-heavy" (320 prompt, 20 token reply) and "reply-heavy" (80 prompt, 250 token reply) to stress both prefix and decode phases. I'll include cold-start queries to measure model load/compile latencies. Will upload to s3://redwood-poc/finsys/replays/1769991234/

sam_soleng: Proposed run recipe: 
```
- Warmup: 15m @ 25 qps (compile + cache fill)
- Ramp: 30m linear to 200 qps
- Steady A: 3h @ 200 qps (context-heavy)
- Spike: 60s burst to 1000 qps
- Recovery: 10m @ 50 qps
- Steady B: 3h @ 200 qps (reply-heavy)
- Cooldown: 15m @ 10 qps
```
This yields two separate steady-state samples for pricing and tail-latency. Any objections to running both on same infra window?

maria_ae: FinSys ok with same window. They asked for token-level cost model for Hosted vs Reserved: show cost-per-1M-tokens and break-even point for 3/6/12 month commit. Can finance help with assumed GPU hourly rates?

ravi_product: I'll calculate estimates. Need measured tokens/sec per GPU and effective throughput at 200 qps under our batching settings. We'll compare: (A) Dedicated commit: monthly GPU amortized + ops addon + per-token infra, (B) Hosted: PAYG token rate + burst credits. Provide model assumptions in the appendix.

alyssa_security: Security constraints: FinSys requires that request traces do not include raw PII in logs. For the dedicated demo we'll ensure request bodies are redacted at the ingress and traces only include token counts and non-sensitive hashed IDs. Also need confirmation on KMS keys: will customer supply KMS or use Redwood-managed? Recommend customer-managed KMS for enterprise readiness.

sam_soleng: Ops note: To meet FinSys isolation rules we'll run in tenant VLAN with no egress to S3 except the dedicated results bucket. We'll mount ephemeral NVMe for temp artifacts and ensure we disable any host-level swap. KV cache flag: --kv-cache=memonly. Run command (draft):
```
./bench --endpoint=https://dedicated.sales.redwood/v1/gen \
  --model=open-llama-7b --qps=200 --dur=10800 --streaming=true \
  --replay=s3://redwood-poc/finsys/replays/1769991234/context-heavy.json \
  --kv-cache=memonly --prom=http://prom:9090 --log-redact=true
```
I'll attach the final command a few hours before run.

jordan_ml: Metrics we'll capture: p50/p95/p99 request latency, tokens/sec, tokens/request, GPU util (mem/SM), power draw, kernel time breakdown, and model compile time. I'll provide Grafana dashboard panels and PromQL queries.

maria_ae: Scheduling: FinSys prefers Friday 2025-12-05 09:00-17:00 PT. Can we do that? Also request a 30-minute executive readout the same day + 2-page summary within 24h.

sam_soleng: I can reserve nodes for Friday. @deploy-bot please provision 6 x A10G nodes in sales-dedicated-2 for 12:00-20:00 PT as a cushion.

deploy-bot: Reservation requested: pool=sales-dedicated-2, nodes=6, window=2025-12-05T12:00:00-20:00:00-08:00. Status: pending ops approval.

maria_ae: Note: FinSys legal also sent a security questionnaire — they want to confirm data residency and logging retention (<30 days). @alyssa_security can you draft answers targeted at a hosted vs dedicated deployment?

alyssa_security: I'll draft a short memo: data residency (region-bound), retention policy (default 30 days, configurable to 0 for PII), KMS options, SOC2 attestation link, and sample redaction policy. Will post in #security and attach to POC package.

ravi_product: Deliverables after run: 1) Executive summary + pass/fail on latency SLO, 2) Detailed perf appendix with token-level cost and break-even calc, 3) Ops runbook used, 4) Security memo and answers to questionnaire, 5) Raw metrics tarball. I'll own the write-up and aim to deliver within 24 hours.

maria_ae: Action items recap:
- sam_soleng: finalize run commands, infra reservation, attach prometheus queries
- jordan_ml: upload replays and dashboards
- alyssa_security: security questionnaire answers + memo
- ravi_product: assemble POC report + pricing comparison

Any blockers? If not I'll confirm Friday with FinSys and send invites.

sam_soleng: No blockers. I'll post the final command and prom queries in #eng-infra 2h before the run.

jordan_ml: Replays will be uploaded by EOD tomorrow to s3://redwood-poc/finsys/replays/1769991234/ and I'll leave a README with generation seed and randomization rules.

maria_ae: Thanks all. I'll confirm with FinSys now. :white_check_mark:
